_why: The type size a person has looked at and called correct, per OS, as the median word height in points on page 2 of print-pagebreaks.md. A platform with no entry here is measured and recorded but never failed: the first run is what produces the number, and only after someone opens that paper and says the type is right. macOS's 18.56 is the print route's own paper (task-27 paper-mac-light-7a.pdf), which is the size the print stylesheet was designed against.
